the technology-assisted cognitive health assessment and intervention is a promising and viable approach to improve the cognitive health of older adults.

the development of a technology-assisted cognitive health monitoring system that can be deployed in a smart home environment to provide continuous and proactive monitoring of cognitive health and behavioral changes.
the development of technology-assisted proactive health monitoring and intervention systems that can be deployed in a smart home setting.
developing technology-assisted cognitive and behavioral health assessment systems that are clinically relevant, cost-effective and scalable for the aging population.

the wearable and IoT technology can help to assess the cognitive and behavioral status of aging population in a non-invasive manner, which can help to improve the quality of life of older adults and reduce the healthcare cost.
